Description
Antigen–Antibodyconfidence: high
This complex shows an antibody fragment (VH and VL chains) bound to human Programmed cell death 1 ligand 1 (PD-L1), an immunoglobulin superfamily protein and BTN/MOG family member. PD-L1 is an immune checkpoint ligand for the inhibitory receptor PD-1 that helps modulate T-cell activation and immune tolerance. The structure captures the antigen-binding interface between the antibody variable domains and PD-L1, a biologically relevant antigen-antibody recognition event.
ReasoningThe structure contains two antibody fragment chains annotated as VH and VL, and a third protein chain matching Programmed cell death 1 ligand 1 (PD-L1). The suggested valid protein-protein contacts show the VH/VL pair binding the PD-L1 antigen chain, which is the defining arrangement of an antigen-antibody complex. No non-solvent small-molecule ligand evidence is provided, so the ligand interaction flag remains false.
